correctness.rationale: The exact generic section face count is the number of (j+2)-vertex simplex faces containing signs on both sides, hence binom(m,j+2)-binom(K,j+2)-binom(m-K,j+2), including K=0,m. Haar normal generated by centered Gaussian variables divided by sample s gives the exact threshold K=sum 1{(Z_i-Zbar)/s>alpha_m}. The empirical cdf expansion at Zbar+alpha_m s yields influence psi=1{Z>alpha}-p-phi Z-(alpha phi/2)(Z^2-1). Orthogonality of first two Gaussian Hermites gives the stated variance, positive because an indicator cannot equal a quadratic almost surely. At p!=1/2 a first-order Taylor expansion of A_j produces joint rank-one Gaussian; at p=1/2 the linear derivative vanishes and the quadratic term yields (G-lambda phi(0))^2/(2^j j!). The integer balanced cutoff contributes a lower-order error. Independent 900,000-sample diagnostics checked corrected variance at alpha=-1,-.3,0,.4,1, not treated as an infinite proof.
